Every run: 12 of 12 episodes scored, no simulation faults, the numerics check and the render self-test passed, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 217 of 217 differing, the same steps per episode in all five (1614-1941); the verify stage took 730-742 s for the 12 episodes.
note: Measured, not drawn.
